previous_statement: Conditional bridge: if B_U oplus B_V is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra and A_R is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra, then the extended delta-isomorphism v from 1.3 and the validated threshold 0 <= delta+epsilon_{A_R} <= e_iso_unit from 1.4 meet every hypothesis of lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control. Consequently ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}|| <= C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R}) <= abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1)*t <= D_3*t.
new_statement: Correct conditional bridge: assume B_U oplus B_V is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, A_R is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra with designated unit u_{A_R}=I_{A_R}, and there exist delta>=0 and an extended delta-isomorphism v:B_U oplus B_V->A_R such that delta<=K*t, epsilon_{A_R}<=t, and 0<=delta+epsilon_{A_R}<=e_iso_unit. Then every hypothesis of lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control is explicit, so ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R})<=abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1)*t<=D_3*t. This is only a conditional implication: it does not assert that such v exists, and in particular it does not obtain v from current node 1.3, which records that the root antecedent is missing the bijectivity needed to produce v.
